Are you currently doing Renee's Request in Crimson Desert? This is an early-game side quest in Hernand, the first town that you visit in the campaign. It's also a task that grants you a pretty nifty reward.

Crimson Desert - Renee's Request guide

You can start the Crimson Desert Renee's Request objective by visiting the Butchery in Hernand. It's at the end of the alley just past the Inn. There, you'll meet the shop owner, Renee, who tells you about her plans to cook a seafood meal. Renee's conundrum is that she's been cooking meat her entire life, and she's never had a chance to cook fish before. She wants you to handle it instead, and she even hands you the recipe and the ingredients.

Aggro Crab announced the collaboration in a YouTube short, which shows four scouts from Peak with Fortnite-character proportions--it looks like these scouts have grown taller after consuming so many berries and hot dogs. The video announces that the Peak bundle releases on March 21.

With all these options, it's only natural you might want a few recommendations to help you narrow it down. With that in mind, can I point you towards some of GameSpot's previous Game of the Year selections?

description:
Polish developer CD Projekt Red has announced that it's hired more than 200 people in the past year, and that the majority of the new hires came aboard to work on The Witcher 4.

As part of CD Projekt's latest earnings report, joint CEO Michał Nowakowski said more than 220 people joined the company's various teams in the past year. "Most" of the new hires are now working on The Witcher 4 to "help improve the quality and scale up" the project.

Specifically, he said the new staff will be working on "solutions" from the Unreal Fest tech demo for The Witcher 4 and trying to implement these things "across the entire game."
title: Witcher 4 And New IP At CD Projekt Get Fresh Updates; Here's The Latest

description:
The creators of free-to-play gacha RPG Duet Night Abyss have publicly apologized for a "cybersecurity incident" that saw players' PCs infected with malware. The incident--which developer Pan Studio is calling a "malicious attack"--took place on March 18 and resulted in malware affecting an unknown number of players. Per a recent post from the official Duet Night Abyss X account, the malware was spread via an update patch for the game's launcher, which went live on Steam at 1:04 PT / 4:04 AM ET on March 18.

title: After Infecting PCs With Malware, Gacha Game Gives Out Free Loot Boxes To Apologize

description:
Kirsten Dunst is joining the cast of A Minecraft Movie 2, and this comes not long after she said she wanted to be in the movie because her kids enjoyed the first one and she likes money.

Deadline, which confirmed Dunst's casting, said there is no word yet on the role she will play. In any event, she joins a cast that includes returning cast members like Jack Black, Jason Momoa, Danielle Brooks, Matt Berry, and Jennifer Coolidge.

Jared Hess, who directed A Minecraft Movie, is coming back for the sequel. Dunst has appeared in 90+ films and shows, and earned an Academy Award nomination for The Power of the Dog. A Minecraft Movie 2 will be her first video game movie, but she is no stranger to a blockbuster franchise, of course, as she starred as Mary Jane in the Sam
title: Kirsten Dunst, Who Wanted To Be In A Minecraft Movie 2, Is Now In A Minecraft Movie 2

description:
Epic Games has launched a brand-new and ambitious-sounding feature for Fortnite, and it's the ability for anyone to make Star Wars-inspired islands using the Unreal Editor for Fortnite (UEFN).

This is part of Disney's $1.5 billion investment into Epic Games, and, in short, what this means is Fortnite players with creativity and passion can make their own Star Wars games and worlds within Fortnite. Given how dedicated the Fortnite community is, it's expected the debut of the new UEFN tools for Star Wars will lead to some impressive creations. It sounds exciting, but there are also some key things to know about rights-usage and other limitations.
title: Fortnite's New Star Wars Map-Making Tools Go Live, But With Some Catches

description:
The new trailer for Spider-Man: Brand New Day hit the internet this week, and it was a giant success, so much so that it surpassed GTA 6's latest record-breaking trailer.

For context, May 2025's GTA 6 trailer reached 475 million views in less than a day, while Brand New Day's trailer surpassed 500 million views in its first 24 hours. description:
McDonald's is rolling out another Mario-themed Happy Meal, this time tied to the upcoming Super Mario Galaxy Movie. The promotion starts in the United States on March 26, about a week before the movie lands in theaters on April 1. Instead of the usual small toys like the first movie's collab, these Happy Meals will feature character keychains.

The main set is expected to include Mario, Toad (possibly styled as Captain Toad), Bowser, Peach, and Luigi in his Frog Suit, which we got a look at in a previous trailer. On top of that, Rosalina and Bowser Jr. are part of the wave, as the cast expands beyond the standard Mushroom Kingdom crew.
title: Mario Returns To McDonald's Happy Meals for Super Mario Galaxy Movie Tie-In

description:
2021's Kena: Bridge of Spirits, which was originally released on PlayStation consoles and PC, is headed to Nintendo Switch 2 very soon. Developer Ember Lab has announced that Bridge of Spirits will hit Nintendo's console on March 26, with preorders opening today from the eShop.

The Switch 2 version of Bridge of Spirits includes the game's previously released Anniversary DLC, which comes with new outfits and accessibility features. Players also get the New Game+ mode.

description:
Ubisoft subsidiary Red Storm Entertainment has just laid off over 100 developers and is ceasing game development, according to new reports.

Both VGC and GamesIndustry.biz reported on the layoffs at the North Carolina game studio on Thursday morning. There were 105 jobs cut as part of Ubisoft's latest round of layoffs, and Red Storm Entertainment will now be a support studio working on the Snowdrop game engine, IT services, and customer relations rather than active game development.

title: Ubisoft Just Ceased Game Development At The Studio That Created Rainbow Six - Report

Black Ops Royale launched last week for Call of Duty: Warzone, but the developer Raven Software is already adding one of the most-requested features to the new mode. A solo playlist is arriving later today, but the developer did warn the gameplay currently isn't tuned for the single-player experience.

Season 2 Reloaded added Black Ops Royale as a brand-new battle royale mode, which is heavily inspired by Call of Duty's original Blackout battle royale that was introduced in 2018. Black Ops Royale mode launched with only the option to play in squads of four, but many players wanted a solo queue to tackle the fight alone.

Raven Software announced the solo playlist will arrive on March 19 at 10 AM PT / 1 PM ET as both a public playlist and a private match option. However, the developer also warned the mode was "originally designed and balanced to launch as a quads experience," a
title: CoD: Warzone's Black Ops Royale Gets A Highly Requested New Playlist

description:
Crimson Desert is out today after over half a decade in development, and the early reviews aren't especially stellar. That may be why the stock price of the game's developer, Pearl Abyss, has dropped nearly 30% since the Crimson Desert reviews were released.

According to Seoul Economic Daily, Pearl Abyss is currently trading at 46,600 won--approximately $31.11 in USD--which is down 28.96% from the 65,600 won/$43.79 price that it had earlier in the week. The game's performance may be concerning investors because it reportedly cost 200,000,000 won/$133.5 million to develop.

GameSpot's Crimson Desert review gave it 7/10 and praised its open-world environment, combat, and traversal, while criticizing the que
title: Crimson Desert Dev's Stock Plunges Following The Game's Reviews

description:
Prime Video's Life is Strange TV series is progressing ahead with the announcement of who will direct the first two episodes. According to Variety, Karyn Kusama has signed on to direct the first and second episodes of the upcoming game adaptation.

Kusama is known for directing the movies Girlfight (which she also wrote), along with Æon Flux, Jennifer's Body, The Invitation, and Destroyer. Perhaps more relevant to Life Is Strange, she also directed episodes of popular TV shows, including The L Word, Halt and Catch Fire, The Man in the High Castle, Masters of Sex, Billions, and Yellowjackets.

In addition to directing Life Is Strange's first episodes, she is an executive producer via her Familystyle production banner. Kusama received three Emmy nominations, all of them for her work on Yellowjackets.
title: Life Is Strange TV Show Adds A Veteran Emmy-Nominated Director

description:
Fortnite's next big crossover is with Game of Thrones, it seems. A report from the Epic-partnered "leak" account ShiinaBR states that the popular characters Daenerys Targaryen, Jon Snow, and The Night King are all coming to Fortnite on March 20 as part of Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 2.

This is the first time that Game of Thrones characters are coming to Fortnite. Numerous other characters and franchises owned by Warner Bros. have been added to Fortnite before, including Mortal Kombat, Harry Potter, and Batman.
title: Fortnite Is Adding These Iconic Game Of Thrones Characters Soon, It Seems

description:
The Chapter 7 Season 2 battle pass has arrived on the Fortnite island. As usual, this pass includes eight new skins, each of which has at least one additional style option and a full slate of accessories. Less usual is the way that this pass has introduced a controversial change to how the battle passes will operate moving forward. The Chapter 7 Season 2 battle pass is slated to run until June 5.

The new battle pass costs 800 V-Bucks, which you may be tempted to think is a price drop since the last past cost 1,000. But that change in price came with an increase in the cost of V-Bucks, so it's effectively the same real-money price as before. And you can only earn back 800 V-Bucks from the pass, down from the 1,500 that was included with every previous full pass.

title: Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 2 Battle Pass: All Skins, Sidekicks, Kicks, And Other Rewards

As the live-action Sonic the Hedgehog 4 movie ramps up production, we finally have official confirmation that Jim Carrey (among other stars) is returning to the franchise, and he'll be joined by other prolific Hollywood actors new to the series.

Per Variety (and initially reported by DanielRPK), Carrey will don the mustache and goggles yet again as Dr. Robotnik, Variety also reported that Idris Elba (Knuckles), Keanu Reeves (Shadow), Colleen O’Shaughnessey (Tails), James Marsden (Tom Wachowski), Tika Sumpter (Maddie Wachowski), and Lee Majdoub (Agent Stone) are returning as well. description: The Legacy of Kain series is steadily making a comeback after decades of hibernation. We've seen ports and remasters of classic games in the series like Soul Reaver and Legacy of Kain: Defiance, as well as a new spin-off game, Legacy of Kain: Ascendance, launching later this month. These releases have been bolstered by graphic novels and other content that flesh out the world-building of the cult-classic vampire fantasy series, including an all-new Legacy of Kain: Map of Nosgoth, coming soon from graphic novel publisher Dark Horse. Illustrated by renowned artist Francesca Baerald, the Nosgoth map pulls landmarks, regions, and fan-favorite characters from across the entire Legacy of Kain series to create a unique work of cartographic art. Priced at $50, it's now available to preorder exclusively through the Dark Horse Direct Store ahead of its release, which is tentatively planned for
title: Legacy Of Kain Fans Can Now Preorder A Stunning Map Of Nosgoth

description:
Crystal Dynamics, the esteemed studio known best for its work on the Tomb Raider franchise, has announced its fourth round of layoffs in the past year alone. The developer said this latest round, which impacted 20 people, was "necessary."

In a post on LinkedIn, Crystal Dynamics said the cuts were split between developers and "central operations" roles. "This is a difficult day for our studio, and we never make these decisions lightly, particularly after the restructuring we underwent last year," the Embracer-owned studio said.

The developer said it is "continuously" looking at the structure and makeup of its teams "to ensure they align with our long-term goals."

Continue Reading at GameSpot
title: Tomb Raider Dev Announces Fourth Round Of Layoffs In Past Year

description:
Counter-Strike is getting one of its biggest gameplay shakeups in years, with a change to ammo management that will force players to be more mindful about how and when they reload. From today, reloading in Counter-Strike 2 will dump the unused ammo from that magazine, replacing it with a fresh magazine from your limited reserves.

In the update announcement, Valve says that the change is intended to make players think before they reload. "When you reload in CS2, the leftover ammo in your magazine is dumped back into an essentially endless reserve supply," the blog explains. "And so the decision to reload has never offered significant trade-offs--in a safe position with enough time, you might reload after firing a single bullet, or half a mag, or after firing down to empty, and the rest of the round would be unaffected."

title: New Counter-Strike 2 Update Completely Changes How You Manage Ammo
